summary: Iter 70 - Fully validated mobile Partner+Merchant Auth port on Expo web (390x844). Backend: 8/8 pytest pass (test_iter70_mobile_auth.py) - POST /api/auth/email with create_if_new:false returns 404 'No account found' and does NOT auto-create; partner.demo@azoapp.test/Partner@123 -> role=partner token; verify-otp with create_if_new:false returns new_user:true and creates NO user; create_if_new:true+role:partner creates partner; re-registering same phone as merchant -> 400 'already registered as partner'; existing customer +919000000004 with role:'partner' -> 400 role_mismatch; forgot-password returns dev_otp; wrong OTP -> 400; correct OTP + Partner@123 -> ok; /auth/me with Bearer token returns user, garbage token -> 401 (partner password reset back to Partner@123 to keep tests idempotent). Frontend: onboarding -> skip-notifications-button -> Login screen with EXACT testIDs (login-title 'Sign in to continue', login-phone-input, send-otp-button, reg-partner, reg-merchant, email-input, email-pass, email-login-btn, forgot-password-link, demo-partner, demo-merchant) and NO customer/admin demo buttons. Validation: empty/5-digit/starts-with-1 all show 'valid 10-digit mobile number' toast and stay on step 1. Valid 9000000003 -> step 2 with +919000000003 caption, 6 boxes otp-box-0..5 auto-filled 123456, resend-countdown 0:28 running, change-number link works; Verify -> partner-home rendered with ph-hero, and page reload keeps user logged into partner dashboard (token persisted). Customer 9000000004 & Admin 9000000000 -> rejected: user stays on login-title, azo_token=null. Email login: invalid format -> 'valid email' toast; unknown valid email -> 'No account found'; partner.demo@azoapp.test/Partner@123 -> partner-home. Register-as-Partner: title 'Register as partner', '← Back to login', reg-merchant hidden; new phone (98765xxxxx) -> Verify -> otp-name-step with login-name-input that filters digits ('Ravi 123' -> 'Ravi ') -> continue-signup-button -> /partner/register wizard (Step 1 of 5 Basic). Register-as-Merchant: new phone -> lands on /merchant/register. No-account step: unknown number without register toggle -> otp-no-account-step 'No Partner or Merchant account found for +91…' with no-account-register-partner + no-account-register-merchant; tapping partner opens name step; completing -> /partner/register. Forgot password: forgot-password-dialog opens; empty identifier -> 'email or mobile' toast; partner.demo@azoapp.test -> dev OTP toast + forgot-otp prefilled + forgot-new-password + forgot-reset -> 'Password reset' toast + sheet closes. Demo: demo-partner -> partner-home; demo-merchant -> Merchant dashboard (Sharma Electricals, Commission, Wallet ₹25,477 all render). Regression: jobs-list rendered on Job Request tab.

validation.ts isPhone10 regex /^[6-9]\d{9}$/ correctly rejects numbers starting with 1-5 as observed.
Backend /api/auth/email with create_if_new:false properly returns 404 without side-effects (verified by 2 consecutive calls both returning 404 - no user created between).
